proposals.rationale: The words 'nuclear propulsion' are the only overlap, and they point at a different program. The index row is an RDT&E development effort for a next-generation fast-attack plant on PE 0603570N 'Advanced Nuclear Power Systems'; the award is a component buy for the Naval Nuclear Propulsion Program funded by 'fiscal 2016 other procurement (Navy); and fiscal 2016 shipbuilding and conversion (Navy)'. The announcement deliberately withholds detail - 'No completion date or additional information is provided on Naval Nuclear Propulsion Program contracts' - so nothing supports attribution to this line.

proposals.program_name: Landing Helicopter Assault (LHA) and Landing Helicopter Dock (LHD) Modernization Program
proposals.announcement_evidence: USS Makin Island (LHD 8) fiscal 2015 phased maintenance availability
proposals.lexicon_quote: Landing Helicopter Assault (LHA) and Landing Helicopter Dock (LHD) Modernization Program
proposals.rationale: Rejected on the platform and appropriation patterns together. 'LHD' here is a hull-type designator for one ship, USS Makin Island, not the LHA/LHD Midlife modernization line named on OPN BLI 0933; the award is a phased maintenance availability, i.e. depot-level ship maintenance, funded by 'Fiscal 2015 operations and maintenance (Navy)'. O&M availability work on one hull is not the procurement line's own modernisation program.
